android.desc:
Take control of your finances with Paisa - the beautiful, privacy-first expense tracker that puts you in charge of your money.

**TRACK EVERY TRANSACTION**
• Add expenses and income in seconds with our intuitive interface
• Categorize transactions with custom categories and colorful icons
• Support for multiple accounts: bank, cash, credit cards, and wallets
• Built-in calculator for quick expense entry
• Smart suggestions based on your spending history

**STAY WITHIN BUDGET**
• Create unlimited budgets for different spending categories
• Visual progress bars show exactly where you stand
• Get notified when approaching budget limits
• Monthly, weekly, and custom budget periods
• Compare actual spending vs. planned budgets

**REACH YOUR SAVINGS GOALS**
• Set financial goals with target amounts and deadlines
• Track progress with beautiful visual indicators
• Link goals to specific savings accounts
• Celebrate milestones as you get closer to your dreams

**SMART INSIGHTS & REPORTS**
• Understand your spending patterns with detailed charts
• Category breakdown shows where your money goes
• Trend analysis reveals spending habits over time
• Period comparison to track improvement
• Export reports to PDF and CSV

**ALL ACCOUNTS IN ONE PLACE**
• Manage bank accounts, cash, credit cards, and e-wallets
• See your total net worth at a glance
• Track transfers between accounts
• Support for multiple currencies

**MAKE FINANCE FUN**
• Earn achievement badges for healthy money habits
• Build streaks for consistent tracking
• Celebrate financial milestones
• Gamification keeps you motivated

**SPLIT BILLS WITH FRIENDS**
• Easily divide expenses among groups
• Track who owes what
• Mark payments as settled
• Perfect for trips, dinners, and shared expenses

**PRIVACY FIRST**
• All data stored locally on your device
• No account required to get started
• Optional Google Drive backup for peace of mind
• Biometric authentication to protect your data
• Your financial data is never shared or sold

**BEAUTIFUL & CUSTOMIZABLE**
• Material Design 3 with dynamic colors
• Light and dark themes
• Multiple accent color options
• Clean, distraction-free interface

**AVAILABLE IN 35+ LANGUAGES**
Including English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Italian, Dutch, Russian, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, Hindi, and many more.

**FREE FEATURES**
• Unlimited transactions
• Custom categories
• Multiple accounts
• Basi
